seo.title: Multiples of 9 Speed Grid - 9s Multiplication Finger Trick Game
seo.metaDescription: Spot all multiples of 9 on a 100-tile grid. Practice 9s times tables and explore the fascinating digit sum patterns of nine.
seo.intro: Multiples of 9 possess one of the most famous patterns in arithmetic: the sum of the digits of any multiple of 9 is always equal to 9 (or a multiple of 9). Furthermore, as the tens digit increases by 1, the ones digit decreases by 1 (e.g. 18, 27, 36, 45, 54, 63, 72, 81, 90). On a 10x10 grid, multiples of 9 create a clean diagonal ray from top right toward bottom left.
seo.howToPlay: Click all multiples of 9 from 9 to 99. Correct tiles turn green with a checkmark. Incorrect clicks flash red and subtract 2 seconds. Find all 11 multiples of 9 to finish.
seo.teacherNotes: Demonstrate the famous digit sum trick to help students quickly verify whether any large number is divisible by 9 (for example, 99 -> 9 + 9 = 18 -> 1 + 8 = 9).

faq.q: What is the digit sum trick for 9?
faq.a: Add all the digits together. If their sum is 9 (or a multiple of 9), the number is a multiple of 9.
